warrant: The graded histories and frames follow the fourth-order constant-coefficient DG diffusion kernels (`dg_diffusion` order 4), a different recovery stencil from second-order diffusion. In `rt_dg_diffusion4_const_3x.c`, `diffusion_coeff` (line 62) is `diffusion_coeff` scales the hyper-diffusion coefficient; the two-ULP variant therefore moves every graded value at the level of the arithmetic, while a wrong fourth-order recovery or a wrong sign of the hyper-diffusion term changes them at order one. The bound atol=1e-11, rtol=1e-11 was set on 2026-09-06 from the calibration selfcheck on the x86 worker 136.114.2.6 (1 cpu, 4 GB, Docker): the two-ULP variant used at most 1.4e-5 of it and the strict-IEEE altbuild at most 7.2e-5 (worst files `q.gkyl` and `q.gkyl`), a headroom of about 13842x over the larger legitimate perturbation, while the faults named above move the graded values at order one.
